step1_figure.circuit_type: Folded-cascode op-amp with class-AB output buffer and gain-enhancement (GE)
step1_figure.description: The circuit combines the folded-cascode OTA with floating current sources and push-pull class-AB output buffer (Fig. 24.44, p. 805) with gain-enhancement auxiliary differential amplifiers with source-follower level shifters (Fig. 24.50, p. 809) regulating the cascode drains, as described in Section 24.4 and Fig. 24.51 on page 808.

gain_enhanced_dc_gain.description: Low-frequency open-loop DC voltage gain with gain-enhancement regulation

equation.formula: A_OLDC_GE = A_OLDC * A_GE = [gmn * (Rocasn || Rocasp) * (gmp + gmn) * (ron || rop)] * [gm * (ron || rop)]
equation.explanation: Gain-enhancement boosts the cascode output resistance by the gain of the regulating auxiliary amplifiers (AGE), multiplying the overall DC gain by AGE.
equation.assumptions: Auxiliary amplifiers provide equal gain AGE = AP = AN and cascode loop remains stable.

sky130_expected.calculation: With I_bias = 10 uA per branch, gmn ~ 350 uS, ro ~ 1 / (lambda * Id) = 1 / (0.1 * 10 uA) = 1 MOhm. First-stage cascode gain ~ (gm*ro)^2 ~ (350u * 1M)^2 ~ 350^2 ~ 1.2e5 (~101 dB). GE amplifier gain AGE ~ gm*(ron||rop)/2 ~ 350u * 0.5M ~ 175 (~45 dB). In practice, short-channel output conductance limits unenhanced DC gain to ~50-55 dB, and GE boosts gain by ~20-25 dB to ~74-80 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Textbook reports 74 dB on p. 809 for the GE folded-cascode op-amp; in SKY130 with typical sizing this ranges from 70 to 80 dB.

unenhanced_dc_gain.description: Open-loop DC voltage gain without gain enhancement

equation.explanation: Product of the folded-cascode diff-amp first-stage gain and push-pull output stage gain.
equation.assumptions: Output stage operates in class AB with both MOP and MON conducting.

sky130_expected.calculation: Folded-cascode stage gain ~ 35-40 dB, class-AB output buffer gain ~ 15-18 dB, yielding total unenhanced gain around 50-55 dB (Baker reports 53 dB on p. 809).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Demonstrates the baseline gain before gain boosting is activated.

auxiliary_amplifier_gain.description: Voltage gain of the regulating auxiliary diff-amp (GE amplifier)

equation.formula: A_GE = A_P = gmp * (ron || rop), A_N = gmn * (ron || rop)
equation.explanation: DC gain of the diff-amp with source-follower level shifters regulating the cascode drain node.
equation.assumptions: Symmetrical biasing and source followers have near-unity gain.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the difference between GE open-loop gain (74 dB) and unenhanced gain (53 dB) reported in text (74 - 53 = 21 dB).

equation.explanation: Unity-gain frequency set by the input stage transconductance gm and Miller compensation capacitor Cc.
equation.assumptions: Cc dominates first-pole roll-off; Cc = 240 fF as specified in netlist.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Textbook mentions fun jumping to ~400 MHz for L=1 and ~100 MHz for L=2; on SKY130 with standard sizing fun lands in 200-400 MHz range.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin of the open-loop response driving 1 pF load

equation.explanation: Phase margin evaluating stability at unity-gain crossover frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Class-AB second-pole frequency f2 = gm_out / (2 * pi * CL) where gm_out ~ 1.5 mS, CL = 1 pF -> f2 ~ 240 MHz. With fun ~ 300 MHz, PM typically ranges between 45 deg and 65 deg.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Design trades off between speed and phase margin; textbook discusses PM around 45° to 60° for similar loaded topologies.

quiescent_power.description: Total quiescent power dissipation of op-amp and bias generator

equation.explanation: Total static supply current drawn from VDD including bias circuits (140 uA), diff-pair, folded cascode, class-AB output, and GE amplifiers (+60 uA).

sky130_expected.calculation: Total IVDD ~ 140 uA (bias) + 20 uA (diff-amp) + 20 uA (cascode branches) + 40 uA (output stage) + 60 uA (GE amps) ~ 280 uA. P_diss = 1.8 V * 280 uA = 504 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Page 809 indicates GE adds ~60 uA to the nominal ~200-240 uA total VDD current.

slew_rate.description: Slew rate driving 1 pF capacitive load

equation.formula: SR = dvout / dt = Iss / Cc (internal) or Iout_max / CL (external)
equation.explanation: Maximum rate of voltage change across compensation capacitor and output load during large transient steps.
equation.assumptions: Iss = 20 uA, Cc = 240 fF, output stage provides class-AB current boost.

sky130_expected.calculation: Internal slew rate limit = Iss / Cc = 20 uA / 240 fF = 83.3 V/us. Class AB output stage can source/sink > 100 uA into 1 pF -> external rate > 100 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Class-AB output eliminates the 20 mV/ns (20 V/us) limit discussed in Eq. (24.48).

settling_time_1pct.description: 1% settling time for an 800 mV step in inverting unity-gain configuration

equation.formula: t_settle ~ t_slew + 4 * tau = t_slew + 4 / (2 * pi * f_un * beta)
equation.explanation: Settling time to 1% of final value under step excitation as shown in Fig. 24.39 and Fig. 24.41.
equation.assumptions: Feedback network with Rf = Rin = 10k, beta = 0.5.

sky130_expected.calculation: tau = 1 / (2 * pi * 300 MHz * 0.5) = 1.06 ns; 4 * tau = 4.2 ns; slew time ~ 0.8 V / (85 V/us) ~ 9.4 ns; total ~ 10-15 ns in inverting loop (Baker reports ~5 ns settling time on p. 804).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Consistent with Baker's report of approximately 5 ns settling time for the L=1 topology.

step3_testbench.description: Complete ngspice simulation testbench measuring open-loop gain, unity-gain frequency, phase margin, auxiliary GE gain, quiescent power, slew rate, and settling time for the gain-enhanced folded-cascode op-amp.
